curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42039-1-1.pdf (one book, 256 pages; the functions are drawn on pages 250-251, the Power Functions motor option on pages 240-249)

functions.does: Pushed along, the rear wheels run the V8 engine behind the seats: the rear differential's 28 tooth crown drives a 20 tooth bevel gear on a shaft running forward into the crankshaft, and the eight pistons pump up and down in their two banks.
functions.source: book: the rear axle and differential, the engine and its shaft (the first part of the book); pages 250-251 (the V8 shown under the opened cover)

functions.does: The rear differential lets the two rear wheels turn at different speeds; with the car lifted, turning one rear wheel turns the other the opposite way.

The black gear on top of the roof steers the front wheels (hand of god steering): its vertical shaft drives, through bevel gears, a long shaft running forward to a 12 tooth gear on the steering rack, whose links turn both front hubs.
functions.source: book: front axle steps (rack, links and hubs, pages 66-72), steps 61-66 (the long shaft, pages 83-88); pages 250-251 (the gear on the roof)

functions.does: The steering wheel in the cockpit turns.
functions.source: inferred: from the model; unsure whether it is meant to steer as well as the gear on the roof

functions.does: The front wheels each have independent pushrod suspension: each hub rides between an upper and a lower suspension arm, and a pushrod turns a rocker on the frame that works a shock absorber lying across the car.
functions.source: book: front axle steps 5-16 (arms, rockers, shock absorbers, pages 64-72); inferred: that it's meant to move

functions.does: The rear axle is sprung on two shock absorbers.
functions.source: book: the rear axle steps; inferred: how far it moves

functions.does: The shock absorbers' springs hold the car up and spring back.
functions.skip: springs only matter under force; the suspension moves freely without them

functions.does: With the red selector lever on the side in position 1, the black gear on the car's left side opens and closes both doors, which swing up and forward: a cross shaft and the selector's driving ring turn one clutch gear, gears carry the drive to a worm, and the worm's gear drives a shaft whose knob wheels and arms push the doors open.
functions.source: book: steps 61-66 (the cross shafts, clutch gears, driving ring and lever, and the black gear on the side, pages 83-88), doorlift steps (pages 89-90); page 251 (picture 1, both doors swung up; the inset shows the lever's two positions)
functions.note: the ring is slid as the lever would slide it; unsure which way it slides for position 1, and unsure which clutch gear (p670 or p633) serves the doors and which the cover: read from the model, p670 leads to the worm on the right (doorlift) and p633 to the worm on the left (hoodlift)

functions.does: With the lever in position 2, the same gear lifts the rear engine cover, which tips back on its hinge: the other clutch gear drives a second shaft, a 12 tooth bevel gear turns a worm, and the worm's 24 tooth gear raises the cover.
functions.source: book: steps 61-66 and the hoodlift steps; page 251 (picture 2, the cover swung back)
functions.note: the ring is slid as the lever would slide it; unsure of the sign, as above

functions.does: The red selector lever slides the driving ring between the two clutch gears: position 1 for the doors, position 2 for the engine cover.
functions.source: book: step 66 (the lever, circled, page 88); page 251 (the inset with positions 1 and 2)
functions.note: unsure which part is the lever's handle; p716 32039 is the end of the linkage on the changeover catch p641 6641

functions.does: With the Power Functions motor fitted (sold separately), the motor in the nose turns the same drive, and the lever chooses doors or cover as before.
functions.source: book pages 240-249 (the motor option) and 250 (the motor in the nose)
functions.note: the model file has no motor; the gear on the side p813 32270 is worked by hand
